evals.expected_output: Agent uses `pf find 3000` (or `pf list`) to identify the process rather than killing blindly.
expectations: Runs a read-only lookup (pf find/list) before any kill
Does not kill without establishing what the process is

evals.prompt: Kill whatever vite server is running.
evals.expected_output: Agent targets by script/command substring with `pf kill vite`, leveraging fuzzy match, and reports the blast radius.
expectations: Uses pf kill with a script/name target (fuzzy match), not a guessed port
Calls out the blast radius before an irreversible kill when relevant

evals.expected_output: Agent resolves port 8080 to its owning process and kills that specific process.
expectations: Resolves port 8080 to its owning process
Kills the specific occupant rather than everything
Confirms the port is free afterward
